interface.title: FLAT: FoLiA Linguistic Annotation Tool (v0.11.6)
interface.stage_of_work: Inspecting, correcting and enriching linguistic annotation of texts that were automatically tagged (here by the Frog NLP pipeline) before they go into a corpus
interface.what_it_is_for: A web editor where a linguist opens a FoLiA XML document, colour-codes one annotation layer at a time across the text, inspects each word's tokens and spans by hovering, and corrects or adds annotations in a per-word dialog, with confidence values and annotator provenance recorded in the file.

data.note: testflat.folia.xml was uploaded as FoLiA XML. It became document 'untitleddoc' under user flat: a Dutch child's essay pre-annotated by Frog with POS, lemma, morphemes, chunks, dependencies, multi-word units and named entities, plus a stored spelling correction zei->zij. On every load an alert said the external Frog set definitions (ilk.uvt.nl) could not be loaded. So class lists for those sets were not offered, and new classes ('loc', 'per') had to be typed by hand. The Namespace dropdown on the upload form was empty, but the upload still worked.

tree.general: Review and improve the linguistic annotation of a text document and record who changed what
tree.specific: Upload a FoLiA document to FLAT, view its Frog annotations, correct and add annotations with confidence and provenance, and edit its metadata. Versioned undo (History & Undo) is also one of the tool's stated purposes, but it was not exercised: this deployment's foliadocserve was started without --git, so the history was empty

features.name: Layer focus colouring with legend
features.general: Pick one category layer and colour every item in a long text by its category, with a legend that matches the colours
features.specific: Annotation Focus menu (POS, Dependency, Entity, Correction, …) colours the tokens and shows 'Legend • <type>' with class swatches and a Hide link; with Correction chosen, corrected tokens are coloured by correction class (Real-word confusion, Non-word error)
steps: choose an annotation type and set
read the colour-coded text against the legend
switch to another type or Clear
serves_tasks: Colour the whole text by the categories of one annotation layer
Add a new category annotation to an item that has none, with a confidence
Add a new category annotation covering several adjacent items

features.name: Interlinear layer labels
features.general: Print secondary annotation values directly above each item, and brackets over multi-item spans, so several layers can be read at once
features.specific: Global annotations > Lemma / Chunk adds lemma rows and chunk brackets (NP, VP, PP …) above the words, together with the focus colouring
serves_tasks: Show extra annotation layers as labels on the text

features.name: Hover inspector with provenance toggle
features.general: Hover an item to see a card listing every annotation on it, with confidence, and optionally who or what produced each one and when
features.specific: The word popup lists Text, Lemma, POS features, Chunk, Dependency head/dependent, Morphemes and Correction with original text; Tools > Show annotator details adds processor, version and date
serves_tasks: Inspect all annotations on one item
See where each annotation came from
Correct an error while keeping the original as a recorded correction

features.name: Per-item annotation editor with edit modes and confidence slider
features.general: Open a form for one item where each annotation can be overwritten, added as new, recorded as a typed correction or offered as an alternative, each with an optional confidence slider
features.specific: Annotation Editor • Word/Token dialog: per-row D / N / C (with correction class dropdown) / A buttons, a confidence checkbox and slider, a New: dropdown with + to add rows (Entity, Chunk, Dependency …), the queue/repeat/console options, and Ok to submit
steps: turn on the needed edit forms in the Edit Forms menu
click a word to open the dialog
edit a value and choose D, N, C (+ correction class) or A
tick confidence and drag the slider
serves_tasks: Turn on the edit modes you need
Correct an error while keeping the original as a recorded correction
Add a new category annotation to an item that has none, with a confidence

features.name: Click-to-extend span selection
features.general: Make a label cover several adjacent items by switching on a selection mode and clicking the extra items in the text
features.specific: Select span> button on an Entity/Chunk/Dependency row turns yellow; clicking words in the text adds them (highlighted yellow); pressing it again ends selection, then Ok creates the span annotation
steps: add or open a span annotation row
click the extra words in the text (drag the dialog aside if needed)
serves_tasks: Add a new category annotation covering several adjacent items

features.name: Original/corrected text toggle
features.general: Switch the running text between its corrected wording and the original wording before corrections
features.specific: Tools & Options > Show text prior to correction replaces corrected tokens with their originals in the running text (zij shown as zei)
steps: choose Show text prior to correction
read the original wording in the running text
serves_tasks: Show the text as it was before corrections

features.name: Key/value metadata table
features.general: Edit free-form document-level key/value fields in a table and save them back to the file
features.specific: Metadata Editor mode: Metadata Field/Key and Value text boxes, + to add a row, Save changes
steps: type a key and a value
see the saved row reappear with a fresh empty row
